comment: Two params carry the maker's tooltip name 'Only Primes': index 41 is the length row and index 40 the step row, confirmed from paramPos, not from the enum order. Keyboard params are numbered upward from the lowest octave. The prime table is indexed after the CV sum is clamped to 0-167, so CV can drive a prime length as high as 997 while the knob alone reaches 139.
